title: spec(userActions.transfer): the published description still says the switch gates only the Change Owner action; it now also gates the offboarding hand-over
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

Filing gate: ② contract text made false — S1 of the L1 review on PR #36869 (card #35399), recorded there in the seat's `## 席位核对` comment on head `a31b2c96ff`.

## What is false

PR #36869 (`Metadata-protocol: semantic`) makes an object's Change Owner switch (`userActions.transfer`) also decide whether the offboarding hand-over moves the object's `owner_id`. The published key's own description still says it gates only the Change Owner action:
- `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` — the `.describe()` on `userActions.transfer` (~4362 on the PR head);
- `packages/spec/src/data/user-action-transfer.ts` — the module text (~55).

An author or an AI reading the schema (or the generated reference docs built from it) learns a narrower meaning than the runtime enforces.

## Expected

Both sentences name both consumers — the Change Owner action and the offboarding hand-over (count and transfer) — and nothing else; regenerate the spec artifacts the `.describe()` change owes (`gen:schema && gen:docs`, `check:generated`). Prose only: no shape, accept-set or default change.

## Order

After PR #36869 merges (it is what makes the sentence false). Kept out of that PR so it stays off the published-schema review face.
